name: Nuclino
label: Nuclino API
description: Nuclino API via OfficialApiNode (nodes/nuclino/api_spec.json). Official Nuclino REST (api.nuclino.com/v0). Team-scoped API key in Authorization with no Bearer prefix (OfficialApiNode auth.type=header). Official docs: https://help.nuclino.com/d3a29686-api. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Nuclino official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"item_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'item_create', 'item_get', 'item_update', 'item_list', 'item_search', 'collection_list', 'user_list'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'item_create'.

schema.label: workspaceId
schema.description: Workspace id for item_create and list/search filters. Example: 7b3c1a2e-....

schema.label: parentId
schema.description: Parent item or collection id for item_create.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Item title for item_create / item_update. Example: Runbook.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Item Markdown content for item_create / item_update.

schema.label: after
schema.description: item_list cursor (item id to start after).

schema.label: User Id
schema.description: Nuclino user id for user_list (GET /v0/users/:id; no list endpoint). Example: 'abc-123'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: item_create, item_get, item_update, item_list, item_search, collection_list, user_list. Default: item_create. Example: item_create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=header (configKey api_key). Official Nuclino sends Authorization: <api_key> with no Bearer prefix. REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: User Id
configurationParameters.description: Nuclino user id for user_list (GET /v0/users/:id; no list endpoint). Example: 'abc-123'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
